leadText: Takashi Teshirogi (Japanese: てしろぎ たかし) is the author and manga illustrator born on October 31, 1963 in , Japan. His Pokémon related works is authoring and illustrating the series Ash & Pikachu and adaptations of the movie and the game Pokémon Battrio. His other works include the series and is affiliated with CoroCoro, publishing many works in the CoroCoro magazines.

Takashi Teshirogi (Japanese: てしろぎ たかし) is the author and manga illustrator born on October 31, 1963 in , Japan. His Pokémon related works is authoring and illustrating the series Ash & Pikachu and adaptations of the movie and the game Pokémon Battrio. His other works include the series and is affiliated with CoroCoro, publishing many works in the CoroCoro magazines.
